node.title: E1 profile-(0,18) energy-12 root/parity screen no-go
node.statement: The all-unit lag set {1,...,11,15} has energy 12, exact parity multiplicity two, a primitive root 148 modulo 257, a uniform positive conjugate-square floor four, and cubic index 378. Thus the autocorrelation/root/parity/positivity screen is nonempty. Its exact norm quotient by 514 is below the official floor.
node.notes: ROUTE CUT 2026-07-29: this is a signed autocorrelation target, not an 18-singleton spectral factor. Its exact resultant shows that norm is selective even though the preceding necessary screens are not.
